frisco.songTitle: (Sittin’ On) The Dock of the Bay
frisco.linePrev: I left my home in Georgia
frisco.lineNext: 'Cause I've had nothing to live for
stanza: I left my home in Georgia
'Cause I've had nothing to live for
And look like nothin's gonna come my way

frisco.linePrev: If I can't have you all the time, I won't have none at all
frisco.line: Oh, I wish I was in 'Frisco in a brand new pair of shoes
frisco.lineNext: I'm sitting here in Nashville with Norman's Nashville blues
stanza: Peaches in the summertime, apples in the fall
If I can't have you all the time, I won't have none at all
Oh, I wish I was in 'Frisco in a brand new pair of shoes
I'm sitting here in Nashville with Norman's Nashville blues
So come all you good time rounders listening to my sound
And then drink a round to Nashville before they tear it down
